purpose: Frozen executable expectations for G1 Services Engine certification

cases.title: Business-scoped Service list
expect: Only active Services for requested business are returned
Ordering is deterministic

cases.title: Same Service code in different businesses
expect: Both definitions may exist
No cross-business collision

cases.title: Duplicate Service code in same business
expect: Mutation is rejected with typed duplicate identity error

cases.title: Inactive Service hidden from new selection
expect: ListServices excludes inactive Service
Historical lookup by explicit identity remains possible if contract permits

cases.title: Offering belongs to selected Service
expect: ListOfferings returns only Offerings under requested Service

cases.title: Cross-business Offering reference rejected
expect: No Offering from another business can be selected by ID alone

cases.title: Fixed price minor units
expect: FIXED price persists integer amountMinor and uppercase currency exactly

cases.title: Free pricing
expect: FREE stores no fabricated monetary amount

cases.title: Quote-required pricing
expect: QUOTE_REQUIRED exposes no fake fixed price

cases.title: Invalid monetary amount
expect: Negative amount is rejected

cases.title: Invalid currency
expect: Malformed currency code is rejected

cases.title: Duration invariant
expect: durationMinutes must be a positive bounded integer
Zero duration is rejected

cases.title: Canonical requirement projection
expect: Offering read returns requirement code/kind/required/config without channel-specific form metadata

cases.title: Missing dependency target
expect: Mutation is rejected before terminal success

cases.title: Self dependency
expect: Offering cannot depend on itself

cases.title: Contradictory direct dependency
expect: Same target cannot be both REQUIRES and EXCLUDES

cases.title: Eligibility ALL predicates pass
expect: Offering is eligible
Reason codes are deterministic

cases.title: Eligibility predicate fails
expect: Offering is ineligible
Configured failureCode is returned

cases.title: Eligibility missing context
expect: Missing required path fails closed rather than coercing to truth

cases.title: Malformed eligibility rule
expect: Rule is rejected with typed validation failure
No arbitrary code execution

cases.title: Deterministic recommendation ranking
expect: Eligible Offerings sort priority DESC then name ASC then offeringId ASC

cases.title: Recommendation excludes inactive Offering
expect: Inactive Offering is not recommended

cases.title: Recommendation explanation
expect: Result contains auditable reason codes for eligibility/exclusion

cases.title: Create revision
expect: New Service/Offering starts at explicit revision

cases.title: Optimistic update success
expect: expectedRevision equals current
Material update increments revision exactly once

cases.title: Optimistic revision conflict
expect: Stale expectedRevision is rejected
Current definition is not overwritten

cases.title: Running Workflow retains selected snapshot
expect: Workflow selecting revision N retains N after catalog publishes N+1
New Workflow reads N+1

cases.title: Exact mutation replay
expect: Same scoped idempotency identity and same fingerprint returns same business result
No duplicate Service/Offering row

cases.title: Mutation idempotency material conflict
expect: Same scoped idempotency identity with different initial material is rejected

cases.title: Idempotency isolated by business
expect: Same opaque key under another business is independent

cases.title: Automotive fixture
expect: Vehicle Care/Basic Wash is represented by generic Service/Offering contracts

cases.title: Veterinary fixture
expect: Consultation/General Consultation is represented by the same contracts and implementation

cases.title: No vertical switch
expect: Services Engine source contains no conditional behavior keyed to synthetic business or vertical names

cases.title: Appointment Service compatibility
expect: RegisterNewAppointment can consume Services Engine Service projection without hard-coded catalog

cases.title: Appointment Offering compatibility
expect: Selected Offering supplies duration and stable revision snapshot to Appointment flow

cases.title: Scheduler authority remains separate
expect: Services Engine does not calculate concrete resource slots
Existing atomic booking conflict regression remains passing
